objective: Proof, written before the run: a cap of d orders refills from a full d-grid; the corner rule keeps every relation of splits; the corner knot set is always a fill and raises the orders at a full grid; a greedy price raises exactly when its increment is below two states; one fill on a line makes exactly two orders; the seed-and-copy rule keeps the orders after its first fill.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): lambda never decreases; the corner rule across crossing splits keeps every relation of splits and so the start's number of orders; a cap of d orders refills from a full d-grid; the corner knot set is always a fill and along a chain of a full grid raises lambda by exactly one, Q_d having none; a greedy price raises at a full non-cube grid iff its increment is below two states; one fill on a line makes exactly two orders; after its first fill the seed-and-copy rule keeps a bipartite crossing graph.
title: Caps, prices, conservation and the arity of one fill
